item.title: Reynard v0.18.0
item.description:
Reynard 0.18.0 | Reynard
## Changes
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.17.1...0.18.0
### New Features - When a webpage uses a keyboard shortcut that conflicts with one of the app's, the first press now goes to the webpage, and a hint appears in the address bar letting you press the shortcut again to trigger the app's.
### Improvements - Scrolling on webpages is now smoother and more accurate. - Improved audio handling, with better echo cancellation, voice processing, recovery after interruptions, and handling of audio device changes.
### Bug Fixes - Fixed an issue where keyboard shortcuts would not be recognized by websites after using Find in Page or a `<select>` element. - Fixed an issue where the image preview and its actions would not work on certain images, such as those requiring authentication or in the WebP format. - Fixed an issue where tapping the status bar to scroll to the top would not scroll completely to the top of the webpage when using the top address bar. - Fixed an issue where touches on some webpages would land in the wrong place. - Added small performance improvements and fixed several UI issues.
### Engine
Updated Gecko to [158.0](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/commit/FIREFOX_158_0_RELEASE) (released Oct 13, 2026).

item.title: Reynard v0.17.1
item.description:
Reynard 0.17.1 | Reynard
## Changes
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.17.0...0.17.1
This is a minor release that fixes issues found in 0.17.0. For the complete list of changes, see the [0.17.0 release notes](https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/releases/tag/0.17.0).
### Bug Fixes & Improvements - Text selections outside input fields now offer more actions, such as Look Up, Find Selection, Translate, and Share. - Fixed a crash when editing in scrollable text fields on iOS 14 and older. - Fixed an issue where touching the selection handles to drag them would clear the selection in text fields on some webpages. - Fixed an issue where the caret and text selection would not stay aligned with sticky text while scrolling. - Fixed an issue where tapping a focused text field or caret would not bring up the edit menu on iOS 17 and later. - Fixed an issue where images copied from another app would not paste into webpages.

item.title: Reynard v0.17.0
item.description:
Reynard 0.17.0 | Reynard
## Changes
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.16.0...0.17.0
### Improvements - The native text input integration has been rewritten from scratch, so typing now feels truly native, supports nearly all iOS text editing behaviors, and is significantly more stable.
### New Features - The address bar now automatically focuses for input on new tab pages when using a physical keyboard. - You can now cycle between tabs using the Ctrl + Tab and Shift + Ctrl + Tab keyboard shortcuts.
### Bug Fixes - Fixed an issue where a tab would appear blank after closing another tab in the tab overview. - Fixed an issue where dragging the iPad floating keyboard or shortcut bar would push the web view upward. - Fixed an issue where taps would sometimes land in the wrong spot on some iframe elements when the scroll to hide toolbar is enabled. - Fixed several UI issues.
### Engine
Updated Gecko to [157.0.1](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/commit/FIREFOX_157_0_1_RELEASE) (released Oct 6, 2026).
